summary: I fixed babel/units.py format_unit so it falls back to the unit's display name when a locale lacks a pattern for the requested length, which cleared the KeyError in the smoke tests; the remaining shard failures (number-symbol and display-name lookups) were fixed concurrently by other fixers, and all 138 shard tests now pass. The last full-suite run I saw gave 6694 passed and 10 failed, with the failures in test_dates, test_support (zoneinfo), messages/test_js_extract, messages/test_frontend and test_setuptools_frontend, none in my shard.
